text:
leo: deploy-bot blocked artifact v4.0.0 (release 2026-04-12). Reason: SBOM signature missing + vuln-scan found 1 medium transitive (libbaz CVE-2026-123). Need decision: rollback, pin, or timeboxed exception?

deploy-bot: preflight: SBOM_SIGNED=NO, vuln-scan: 0 high, 1 medium (transitive), 0 low. Policy: HOLD until SBOM signed or security exception.

hana: looping in @mike (security). This is during our change window but we might do a 2-step: manual cosign then 20m 2% canary if re-scan OK.

mike: quick triage: CVE-2026-123 affects a build-time helper not present in final image. Likely low risk, but need signature attached and a clean re-scan. If both satisfied, security will grant a 20-minute exception at 2% with auto-rollback triggers.

leo: performing manual cosign: `cosign sign --key k8s://projects/rel/keys rel-v4.0.0.tar.gz`

deploy-bot: cosign: OK 9f2 signature attached. SBOM uploaded to s3://sboms/2026-04-12/v4.0.0.sbom.json

leo: re-running vuln-scan: `./tools/vuln-scan --sbom s3://.../v4.0.0.sbom.json`

deploy-bot: vuln-scan: 0 high, 0 medium, 0 low.

mike: granting 20m 2% exception token `sec-exc-3625001111-1`. Conditions: immediate rollback if 5xxs > 2x baseline OR new med/high detected. I'll monitor.

legal: legal note: add attestation sentence to release notes and open audit task REL-2026-789.

leo: starting 2% canary in eu-west-1 with flag `canary_v4_0_0=true`, start_ts=3625001400, auto-rollback 20m.
deploy-bot: rollout started: eu-west-1 2% traffic. Monitoring hooks active.

mike: 10m check: metrics normal. No revocation.

leo: 20m elapsed, no triggers. proceeding with progressive rollout per playbook. Closing exception token.

deploy-bot: rollout continued. Thread will auto-archive in 7 days.
